run_grpc_abort_tests: run the unittest suite to test gRPC server context abort mechanism behavior
test_abort_unary_unary: test that servicer_context.abort raises RpcError with INTERNAL status code and details
test_abort_with_status: test that abort_with_status returns RpcError with trailing metadata attached
test_invalid_code: test that passing an invalid status code to abort returns UNKNOWN status code
review_GenericHandler_service: review the GenericRpcHandler service method that routes RPC calls to abort handlers
